verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a public, OpenAI-compatible API at api.fireworks.ai. The docs cover tool calling, structured outputs, batch inference, documented request parameters (service_tier) and headers (x-session-affinity), and machine-readable llms.txt and markdown docs are live. Management tasks such as LoRA deployment are documented through the firectl CLI rather than shown as REST endpoints. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI spec (every probed path returned 404), clear REST API evidence for management operations like deployments and fine-tuning, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
